name: @slopz/cli
description: Developer CLI for configuring Slopz games, environments, and banner slots

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', { force: true })"
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node test/validate-package.mjs
